remediation_scope: frontend response contract now models accepted/sent/failed/skipped/not_configured and removes the local narrowing cast
professor feedback states accepted as provider acceptance awaiting delivery confirmation
manual-review endpoint returns 201 only for a newly created review and 200 with reuse-specific message for an existing pending review

controls.positive: accepted is a first-class delivery status in the web service contract
controls.negative: accepted is not classified or worded as sent/delivered

controls.positive: reviewCreated=true maps to HTTP 201 and creation message
controls.negative: reviewCreated=false maps to HTTP 200 and reuse message
controls.regression: response payload remains the createManualReview result

controls.method: delta isolation against prior certified material
controls.detail: The material delta is limited to aluno.routes.ts, aluno.service.ts and AlunoRevisoesCadastraisTab.tsx; provider adapters, callback authentication, Serializable dedupe, monotonic delivery state machine and their focused tests are unchanged from the previously certified material.

remote_observation.policy: single observation performed immediately after publishing the material SHA; no polling/rerun/dispatch

limitations: connector-only runtime prevented local repository test execution; exact-SHA static controls and unchanged inherited runtime controls were used, with remote CI left to its normal trigger
